orchestrationTrigger.notCalibrated: Volt's subagents start from the delegate_task tool (the Multitask chip); the one-line trigger has not been proven on C1 in the ademark user

notes: Draft from round 3 of Volt's own benchmark work (2026-11-13), in a normal account with an isolated HOME, not the ademark user. Rects were read from the DOM with the viewport emulated at 1600 x 1000 (the laptop screen is 1512 x 982 points), so a person must confirm them on a real 1600 x 1000 window before the gate.
composerRect and launchComposerRect: the empty draft's composer, centred (a new thread and a launch both show it). activeComposerRect: the follow-up composer at the bottom of an open thread.
Sidebar rows sort by recency, 46 pt tall from y 168: the long thread built last is the first chat row (y 191), a seed thread the second (y 237). The 'New Agent' draft row sits above them at y 123.

The seed holds the Claude agent profile with Opus 5.5 at High (volt.runtime.modelOptions in agentServer/application.vscdb), the default access mode Full access (volt.runtime.accessMode) and the first-run setup marked shown (~/.volt/setup-shown). User settings: security.workspace.trust.enabled false, volt.agent.defaultModel agent:seed-claude-code:claude-opus-5-5.
Volt lists Claude's models only when ~/.claude.json names an account (oauthAccount.emailAddress). The ademark user's subscription login has one; an API-key-only login shows no Claude models.

The agent sandbox is on by default (workspace write). Volt 0.0.6 refuses the replay server's loopback port inside it; builds after commit 6cc80c0a9bd grant the port of the CLI's *_BASE_URL. On 0.0.6 the sandbox must be off for Track A, and that is a pin to publish.
The agent server is a launch agent (com.volt.agent-server.<12 hex of sha256 of the user data folder>) that keeps running after Cmd+Q by design; A9 counts it.
waitDone idleFallback is on: a sandboxed chat runs Claude with its config under ~/.volt/sandbox/agent-state, so its session log is not under ~/.claude/projects.
agentGuide: Cmd+N opens a new draft in the current project with its composer focused. The model chip sits under the composer text.
